messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Do not take sertraline with a monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI).
Do not take sertraline within 14 days of stopping one.
This is because of the risk of serotonin syndrome.
This includes the antibiotic linezolid and intravenous methylene blue.
You also need to wait at least 14 days after stopping sertraline before starting an MAOI.
Do not take sertraline with pimozide, an antipsychotic medicine.
Do not take sertraline oral solution if you take disulfiram (Antabuse), because the solution contains alcohol.
Sertraline can raise the risk of bleeding.
This risk is particularly high if you also take aspirin.
It is also high if you take NSAIDs such as ibuprofen or naproxen.
The risk increases if you take other antiplatelet medicines.
The risk increases if you take warfarin.
The risk increases if you take other anticoagulants.
Screening for a personal or family history of bipolar disorder, mania, or hypomania is recommended before starting sertraline.
Treating a depressive episode with an antidepressant can trigger a manic episode.
This risk applies to someone with bipolar disorder.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "increases risk when taken with", "other antiplatelet medicines"]

The relation 'increases risk when taken with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug increases the risk of a specific adverse effect or condition when taken in combination with the substance or drug specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
C. 'has interaction effect': The subject drug, when interacting with other substances, may cause the specific effect or outcome described by the object entity.
D. 'has side effect more likely in': The subject drug is more likely to cause the specified adverse effect or reaction in the population or group specified by the object entity.
E. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
